resources.string: Put both devices on the same Wi-Fi or turn on Tailscale on both.
Open a terminal in the folder with sunlith-computer.zip. Requires Node.js 22 or newer.
Open PowerShell in the folder with sunlith-computer.zip. Requires Node.js 22 or newer.
Start a new assistant session and ask it to list your calendars.
Add the sunlith entry from the command output to your client’s MCP settings. Then ask your client to list your calendars.
